thread:
Zoe Park: quick UX note from support: customers report legend keys in dark mode sometimes disappear in exported PDFs.
Milosz Nowak: thanks — do we have an example export?
Zoe Park: attached in ticket: https://tickets.redwood/1234-export-pdf. The colored swatches are extremely low-contrast, and when printed in grayscale some rows look identical.
Aria Chen: are these the small 10px legend swatches next to series names? Iirc we render them with 12% opacity over `--panel-bg`.
Zoe Park: yup. current token: `--legend-swatch-alpha: 0.12` and swatch size 10x10. In PDF they become faint blobs.
Milosz Nowak: two quick fixes: increase swatch alpha to 0.22 and bump to 12x12. Also add a 1px border (`rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`) so they keep definition when rasterized.
Aria Chen: +1. Also we should not rely solely on hue. Add a subtle pattern glyph for each series that shows in print/grayscale (circle, diagonal, dot) and add `aria-label` for programmatic identification.
Zoe Park: support also mentioned the inline legend text uses `--muted-fg` which is barely visible on some monitors. It reads at ~3.1:1. Needs 4.5:1.
Milosz Nowak: propose switching `--legend-fg` to #cfe7ff in dark mode. That hits ~4.8:1 on our panel bg.
Aria Chen: chart palette: current gradients for latency use three near-cool tones which fail for deuteranopes. Suggest colorblind-safe default: #4AA3FF (blue), #FF9F5A (amber), #2AB9A3 (teal). Keep vivid toggle for customers who want saturated variants.
ContrastBot: accessibility-scan v3.1: findings: legend swatch alpha <0.15 (fail for print), legend text contrast 3.1:1 (fail WCAG 2.1 AA), color palette ambiguous for deuteranopia (fail). Recommendations: swatch alpha >=0.2, text contrast >=4.5:1, adopt colorblind-safe palette or add non-color encodings.
Zoe Park: can frontend add a feature flag to render patterned legend for `export=pdf`? That avoids changing live visuals for everyone.
Milosz Nowak: yes. we'll implement patterned swatches for exports + the alpha/border bump for on-screen. PR will include before/after export screenshots.
Aria Chen: I'll draft the tiny copy tweak in the console settings: "High-contrast charts (prints and exports)" with short inline help text. Keeps customers aware.
Zoe Park: perfect. please tag design & support when PR is up.
Milosz Nowak: aiming to open PR today EOD PST.
Zoe Park: thanks team :sparkles:
